name: save-load
description: Deterministic clean-boot NORMAL game-save LOAD proof (issue #13 Part C). Phase A replays new-game.json's exact input verbatim (title A/START cadence at 90..550, then three ordinary A confirmations at 950/1050/1150: New Game -> Easy -> first empty slot) to CREATE a Prologue game save in slot 0 via SaveMenuWriteNewGame()/WriteGameSave(); 'pre-write-empty-slots' (frame 1140) captures the pre-write whole-SRAM hash and 'new-game-created' (frame 1400) captures the post-write hash -- they differ, proving the slot-0 write actually happened -- while its probes read gPlaySt.gameSaveSlot=0x00, chapterIndex=0x00 (CHAPTER_L_PROLOGUE), faction=0x00 (FACTION_BLUE), and the non-zero playthrough discriminants playthroughIdentifier=0x01 and chapterModeIndex=0x01 (CHAPTER_MODE_COMMON, set because the game was created on Easy/tutorial). Phase B holds the A+B+SELECT+START GBA soft-reset combo for a wide window (frames 1600..1680); 'post-soft-reset-reinit' (frame 2550) proves RAM was reinitialised -- gPlaySt.playthroughIdentifier and chapterModeIndex are BOTH back to 0x00, i.e. NOT the loaded values yet, separating a genuine load from mere RAM retention. Phase C skips the re-boot logos/title with START presses only (START is inert on the Save Menu main loop, so no START can select a menu item); Phase D then presses A once to select RESTART -- which InitSaveMenuChoice() lists at cursor index 0 when a game save is present and no suspend save exists -- and A again to confirm slot 0. Per src/savemenu.c PostSaveMenuHandler, RESTART (bit 0x02) matches the `main_sel_bitfile & 0x82` branch that calls ReadGameSave(proc->sus_slot) + SetNextGameActionId(sus_slot+1) -- a NORMAL game-save load, DISTINCT from the RESUME branch (`main_sel_bitfile & 1` -> ReadSuspendSave). 'restart-load-complete' (frame 3300) proves ReadGameSave(0) repopulated gPlaySt from slot 0: gameSaveSlot=0x00, chapterIndex=0x00, faction=0x00, and the discriminants playthroughIdentifier=0x01 / chapterModeIndex=0x01 are back exactly as saved -- semantic state, not a framebuffer. Uses only the check-time-generated CURRENT-format SRAM fixture (write-deterministic-current) as starting SRAM; no savestate, save file, or raw SRAM write is used and no binary is committed.
